\begin{chapstatus}{The thread of this chapter}
Every lw and sw of the course is a short dialogue on the address bus, the data bus and two control lines; a device answers on the same bus. Next: memory that survives without power, and caches.
\par\medskip\textbf{Exit ticket} (two to four minutes, alone, on paper):
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item List, in order, what travels on the address bus, the control lines and the data bus while the processor executes lw t1, 0(t0).
\item RISC-V has no input/output instructions. How, then, does a program turn on an LED or send a pixel to a device?
\end{enumerate}
\end{chapstatus}
